help: I am VocaMind, your voice-enabled AI chatbot! I can answer questions about business hours, pricing, orders, account reset, support, and more. Try speaking or typing your question.
Here is what I can help with: Account assistance, order tracking, refund policies, technical support, working hours, and pricing plans. Just ask me!
working_hours: Our customer support and business operations are active Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST, and Saturday from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM EST.
We are open Monday to Friday (9 AM - 6 PM EST) and Saturday (10 AM - 4 PM EST). We are closed on Sundays.
location: Our headquarters is located at 100 AI Tech Boulevard, Suite 500, Tech City, CA 94016.
VocaMind is headquartered in Tech City, California, with global cloud support operations worldwide.
contact: You can reach our customer support team by email at support@vocamind.ai or call us toll-free at +1 (800) 555-VOCAMIND.
Feel free to email us at support@vocamind.ai or give us a call at +1 (800) 555-8622.
services: VocaMind provides automated Speech Recognition, Deep Learning Intent Classification, Intelligent Response Generation, and Voice Synthesis solutions for enterprise and academic applications.
We offer natural voice interface integration, deep learning NLP chatbots, automated query resolution, and real-time speech analytics.
pricing: We offer three tiers: Starter (Free tier with 1,000 requests/mo), Professional ($29/month with voice support), and Enterprise (Custom pricing with dedicated SLA).
Our plans start with a Free Trial, followed by Professional at $29/mo and Enterprise customized solutions. Visit our website for detailed breakdown.
password_reset: To reset your password, click on the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page. Enter your registered email address, and we will send you a password reset link.
You can reset your account password by navigating to Account Settings > Security > Reset Password, or requesting an email recovery code.
account_help: For account management, visit your Profile Settings dashboard. You can update your email, profile picture, security preferences, or manage your subscription.
You can manage your account details easily in the user profile menu. Contact support if you need help recovering account access.
order_status: To track your order, please provide your 8-digit Order ID. You can also view live tracking updates under your account's 'My Orders' tab.
Your order status can be checked anytime in the Orders section of your profile, or by quoting your Order Confirmation ID.
cancel_order: Orders can be cancelled within 2 hours of placement directly from your account dashboard under 'My Orders'. If the item has already shipped, you can initiate a return upon arrival.
To cancel an unfulfilled order, navigate to 'My Orders' and select 'Cancel Order'. If processed already, our team can help issue a return label.
refund: Our refund policy allows full refunds within 7 days of purchase for eligible items. Standard processing takes 3-5 business days back to your original payment method.
Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days upon request approval. Items must be returned in original condition within 7 days.
payment: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and encrypted online wire transfers.
You can complete payments via major credit/debit cards, PayPal, UPI, or Apple Pay. All transactions are 256-bit SSL encrypted.
technical_support: If you are facing technical errors, please try refreshing your browser or clearing browser cache. You can also report technical bugs to tech-support@vocamind.ai with error details.
Our technical team is ready to assist! Try clearing cache or updating your application. For system bugs, reach out at tech-support@vocamind.ai.
complaint: We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. We take complaints very seriously. Please share details with us at feedback@vocamind.ai so a manager can investigate.
We are deeply sorry for your experience. Please let us know what went wrong, and our escalation team will address your concern immediately.
general_question: VocaMind is an academic college project demonstrating an end-to-end Voice-Enabled AI Chatbot using Speech Recognition, Deep Learning (BiLSTM), and Speech Synthesis.
VocaMind combines web-based Speech Recognition, Deep Learning intent classification with Keras Bidirectional LSTM, and Text-to-Speech playback.
